policy: G7 pure core plus Moabom extension layer plus minimal overlay patch.

move.reason: GCS driver validation should move to a settings-driver extension hook when upstream supports runtime driver registration.
GCS driver validation should move with SaveSettingsRequest to an extension-owned registry contract.
Storage-driver named disk mapping is Moabom runtime policy and should move behind an extension provider hook after upstream exposes one.
Bootstrap settings cache/storage behavior is mostly covered by Moabom repositories and should be reduced once provider construction is injectable.
GCS registry/default should become extension-provided driver metadata instead of a core list edit.
Moabom default storage driver should be seeded by tenant/system settings rather than changing upstream defaults.
Absolute core asset URL and font policy can move to template/view overlay or asset URL configuration.
Absolute core asset URL and font policy can move to template/view overlay or asset URL configuration.

upstream-hook.reason: Generic skip_request_patterns and skip_route_names hooks contain no Moabom hardcoding.
Generic config_clear_guards hook lets extensions suppress destructive clears safely.
Generic extension hook configuration for config clear and identity policy middleware.
Computed-state recalculation hook is a generic template-engine improvement, but remains overlay until upstream accepts it.
Type contract cleanup for render/actionId/devtools debounce tracking; no Moabom-specific handler logic.

overlay-required.reason: Cloud Run public boot cache version fallback is needed before a cleaner upstream cache hook exists.
Cloud Run boot without .env plus module route cache behavior is required during Laravel bootstrap.
Cloud Run boot without .env guard is required during Laravel bootstrap.
Cloud Run proxy trust must be active at HTTP bootstrap time.
GCS filesystem provider must be registered before settings are loaded.
Runtime cache TTL keys must exist in config cache for Cloud Run/SaaS boot.
Cloud SQL persistent/SSL settings must be present before database bootstrap.
GCS disk and named disk templates must exist before storage manager resolution.
SaaS environment SSOT must be available under Laravel config cache.
